To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 36/8 fractional slot winding configuration is the best for the delta-shape magnet configuration.
the 36/8 IPMSMs with delta-shape magnets are the best choice for low-speed torque quality, while the 36/7 IPMSMs with V-shape magnets are better for high-speed torque quality.
36/8 IPMSM with double V-shape magnet topology has better torque performance than other motor configurations at both low and high speeds.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the investigation of slot-pair combination of IPMSM with different magnet toplogies.
the design and optimization of IPMSM with different magnet configurations.
the investigation of slot-poles combinations for the interior permanent magnet synchronous motors with different magnet toplogies.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 36/8 IPMSM with delta-shape magnet topology is the best option in terms of torque density, torque quality, torque ripples and radial force.
36/8 IPMSM with double V-shape magnets has the best torque quality among all the investigated motor models.
36/8 fractional slot IPMSM with delta-shaped magnet topology is a better choice for high torque density applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
36/8 fractional slot configuration is better than 48/8 integer slot configuration.
the delta-shape magnet topology is the optimal magnet topology for 36/8 IPMSM.
the slot-pole combinations are very critical for torque quality of the IPMSM.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for a given magnet configuration, the slot-pole combination has a great effect on torque and force waveforms.
the slot-pole combinations have significant effects on torque quality, radial forces and magnetomotive force (mmf) harmonics.
36/8 IPMSMs have a better torque quality than the integer-slot IPMSMs.
